निडीनं The downward flight or
swoop of birds; see डीन.

नीडः, --डं [नितरामिलंति खगा अत्र
निइल्-क लस्यडः Tv.]
1 A bird's nest;
Ś. 7. 11.
--2 A bed, couch.
--3 A lair, den.
--4 The interior of a carriage.
--5 A
place in general, abode, resting place
--Comp.
--उद्भवः, --जः a bird.
